readme:
# DataForSEO Google Related Keywords API

Retrieve related Google search queries that appear in shared search engine results pages. Analyze overlapping SERP appearances to discover semantically linked search terms.

## Use cases

- Discover alternative search queries that rank alongside target keywords.
- Identify semantic keyword clusters based on shared Google SERP positions.
- Expand keyword research with terms that appear in overlapping search results.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/dataforseo_labs/google/related_keywords/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "running shoes", "limit": 5, "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint (one task per call). Fields used above:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keyword` | Search query. |
| `limit` | Maximum number of results (up to 100). |
| `location_code` | Location code, e.g. 2840 for the United States. |
| `language_code` | Language code, e.g. "en". |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [DataForSEO Backlinks Anchors](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/anchors/live): Returns anchor text distribution metrics for backlinks pointing to a target website or page.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks List](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/backlinks/live): Returns a list of external backlinks pointing to a specified target domain or webpage.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks Bulk Ranks](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/bulk_ranks/live): Returns rank metrics for multiple domains or pages in bulk.
